hero.subtitle: Digital Health Memory was born from a simple yet radical idea: your medical data belongs to you. We've created a restorative digital environment where complexity dissolves into clarity, and security is the foundation of care.

mission.title: Our Mission: Patient Agency
mission.description: We bridge the gap between fragmented medical centers. Your lab tests, X-rays, and prescription history are securely stored in one location, instantly accessible whenever and wherever you need them.

unified_id.title: Unified ID Access
unified_id.description: Medical centers use your National ID to upload results directly. No more manual entries or redundant physical copies.

family_care.title: Family Care Circles
family_care.description: Health is a shared journey. Create secure circles to manage care for elderly parents or children. Get real-time notifications for medication dosages and appointment reminders.

ai_insights.title: Intelligence That Heals
ai_insights.description: Our AI doesn't replace doctors—it empowers you. Get plain-language interpretations of complex lab results and personalized dosage recommendations based on your unique metabolic profile.
ai_insights.observation_text: "Your ferritin levels are slightly below baseline. We recommend increasing leafy green intake before your follow-up."

security.title: Trust is Our Highest Priority
security.description: Digital Health Memory (DHM) employs bank-grade security protocols to ensure your sanctuary remains private and impenetrable.
security.enc_desc: Military-grade AES encryption for all data at rest and in transit.
security.hipaa_desc: Fully compliant with international healthcare privacy standards.
security.bio_desc: Your records are accessible only through your unique biometrics.
